title: Weaver's Cosmetics: Vanity Compat
description: An Official port of Weavers Cosmetics, to work with Farcrs Vanity mod
body:
### Summary:

Weaver's Cosmetics is a Neoforge mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that adds in many unique cosmetic outfit items to the game. In the base mod these aren't available in survival, but are intended for server/modpack makers to implement their own way. This compat pack adds in my cosmetics by integrating them into Farcr's "Vanity" mod, allowing for any player to find them in survival.


**Note:** In the initial releases, there are currently only limited sets added so far, but I'll eventually port over all my cosmetics into the Vanity ecosystem, and likely create a sister-mod to also add in the crossover content from Weaver's Cosplay too.



### List of Current Cosmetics:

Stalwart Sentinel set (Knights armour, Helmet, Chestplate, Legs and Boots) - 5 colourways



### How to Obtain:

Find a Stylist villager, who will sell you the cosmetics from this addon pack



### Dependencies:

- Geckolib
- Vanity: Core


### Future Plans:

Port the remaining items from Weaver's Cosmetics



### Modpacks & Mod Edits:

I give permission to use the above described mod in any Curseforge or Modrinth modpacks that do not charge users for their use (though optional donations or Patreon, etc towards upkeep of modpack/server is acceptable). Please credit appropiately with at least a name, and link back to this page where/if possible.  If you would like to edit the mod, please contact me either by comment or by private message to discuss, as I don't give any permission to modify the above described mod unless you have asked directly, and even then permission is only be granted on a case-by-case basis. If permission is granted, then you would need to inform your players of the changes and notify them that these are your own modifications and not mine.
